description:
[EU high-risk third country screener & FATF blacklist auditor. Deterministic check, read-only, side-effect free]. Screens counterparties against Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1675 and FATF lists, enforcing mandatory Article 29 Enhanced Due Diligence and correspondent banking prohibitions.
Usage: Screen any counterparty jurisdiction to detect strategic anti-money laundering deficiencies and determine required countermeasures.
Returns: JSON object with { countryIso2: string, countryName: string, isHighRiskThirdCountry: boolean, riskCategory: string, mandatoryEddCountermeasures: array, correspondentBankingProhibition: boolean }.

countryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of counterparty entity or financial institution

name: high_risk_jurisdiction_screener
